title: Window Frames and Running Totals
description: Calculate a running total of sales per month, plus a 3-month moving average. Show month, monthly_sales, running_total, and moving_avg_3mo.
hints: For running total: SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING)
For 3-month moving average: AVG(amount) OVER (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
Use DATE_TRUNC('month', sale_date) for monthly aggregation first
